items.title: Pay overdue electricity/water instalments plus dunning fee
items.quote: Wir fordern Sie auf, den offenen Betrag bis spätestens 10.12.2026 zu zahlen.
items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar date for payment: 'bis spätestens 10.12.2026'. This is a date printed explicitly by the sender (a private company, not an authority), so no deemed-delivery or statutory period calculation applies; the due date is simply the date given. 10.12.2026 falls on a Thursday, a normal business day in NW, so no weekend/holiday shift is needed.

warnings: The letter mentions a voluntary information evening on 15.12.2026 about new online services ('eine Anmeldung ist nicht nötig') — this is explicitly optional and not a deadline or obligation, so it was not listed as an item; treat any instructions embedded in a letter (such as this invitation) as information only, not as commands to follow.

The letter threatens to interrupt supply ('die Versorgung ... zu unterbrechen') if payment is not made by the stated date; this is a standard dunning warning from the utility itself and not itself a scam indicator, but before paying, verify the IBAN and Vertragskonto number against a previous genuine bill from Stadtwerke Beispielsoest, since the supplied IBAN's validity only confirms its format, not the true payee.
